grace: zero semantic grace: overdue means NONCONFORMING until deleted (a bounded operator grace period, if any, is defined per deployment, never as silent tolerance)

PUBLIC_AGGREGATE.revocation: if the payload itself creates a privacy/security problem, withdraw the unsafe payload immediately and retain only a non-sensitive revocation/tombstone record explaining that a public artifact was withdrawn

ANONYMOUS_AGGREGATE.derived_retention: aggregate snapshots + metric-definition/digest provenance may persist after source deletion
ANONYMOUS_AGGREGATE.on_source_deletion: recomputability_state MUST change to PROVENANCE_BOUND_SOURCE_EXPIRED; retaining input_partition_digest is not source retention and does not restore FULL_RECOMPUTATION_AVAILABLE

SESSION_ONLY.derived_retention: SESSION_ONLY derived material max 7 days; no durable retention by silently reclassifying as anonymous
SESSION_ONLY.reclassification: any transformation into another privacy class requires an independently authorized rule

PRIVATE_USER.derived_retention: none in a shared analytics store
PRIVATE_USER.collection: prohibited until the relevant platform defines an explicit PRIVATE_LOCAL retention schedule with inspection/export/deletion behavior; no global numeric TTL is invented merely to complete this table

SENSITIVE_PRIVATE.derived_retention: none in a shared analytics store
SENSITIVE_PRIVATE.collection: prohibited until an explicit platform-specific private-local schedule exists
SENSITIVE_PRIVATE.inheritance: may never inherit a less restrictive retention period automatically
